evidence.quote: this mechanism sits *after* the last gain stage, so in state S3 the front end still sees the full input and still compresses identically; OIP3 falls with the gain and **IIP3 is unchanged**. Judged at S3 with this mechanism, D5 fails by the same 21.6–25.4 dB it fails by at S0.

both harnesses agree the OIP3 is pinned at **−1.3 … −2.3 dBm at max gain** and falls with the gain to **−13** at the D6 S3 min-gain state while IIP3 stays at **−33 … −34** — the §2.3 / §42.6 finding, confirmed cross-method: the output-side D6 mechanism buys **0 dB IIP3**.

**ΔG = −9.32 dB of front-side attenuation buys ΔIIP3 = +10.07 dB** — the §42.6-item-1-in-reverse mechanism §2.3's ~12 dB half assumed, measured slightly *better* than dB-for-dB ... So the physics of front-side gain control works exactly as the WP's decomposition assumed; what this topology forbids is doing it **match-legally**

rule: When a linearity spec is quoted at a min-gain state, put the gain-control attenuation AHEAD of the nonlinearity (front-side): output-side attenuation lowers OIP3 with the gain and buys exactly 0 dB of IIP3, while front-side attenuation buys IIP3 ~dB-for-dB with the span — but only at a node whose loading is match-legal, so measure the match-legal span before counting on it.

applicability.applies: Any programmable-gain LNA whose linearity gate is at min gain; measured three times output-side (0 dB IIP3 at S3) and once front-side (+10.07 dB from −9.32 dB of attenuation). The decomposition of a min-gain requirement into 'gain-move + residual OIP3' is only valid if the gain-move is legally front-side.
applicability.not: Front-side gain control is worth 0 dB if there is no match-legal node to attach it to — on this topology every front-side node is match-forbidden (see match-forbidden-zone-is-architectural), so the +10.07 dB was measured only in a MATCH-ILLEGAL state and is void for any claim. The dB-for-dB credit is contingent on the span, not automatic.
